items.followUp: What is the period between meiosis I and meiosis II called, and does DNA replicate during it?

accept: between meiosis i and meiosis ii
rubric.why: Interkinesis is the interval separating the two meiotic divisions.
rubric.description: Places interkinesis between meiosis I and meiosis II.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating when interkinesis occurs.

rubric.why: DNA replication does not occur during interkinesis.
rubric.description: States that DNA is not replicated during interkinesis.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for identifying the absence of DNA replication.

modelAnswer: Interkinesis is the short interval between meiosis I and meiosis II.
DNA replication does not occur during this interval.

items.followUp: How do enzymes affect the rate of a chemical reaction?

rubric.why: Enzymes lower the activation energy needed for a reaction.
rubric.description: States that enzymes lower activation energy.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for the correct effect on activation energy.

rubric.why: Lower activation energy allows the reaction to proceed faster.
rubric.description: Links the reduction in activation energy to a faster reaction.
rubric.how: Award 1 mark for stating that the reaction proceeds faster.

modelAnswer: Enzymes lower the activation energy required for a chemical reaction.
This makes the reaction proceed faster.
